title: 8-bit up/down counter with 3-state outputs

sources.document: Monolithic Memories LSI Databook, 6th ed. (1985), section 6, SN54/74LS469 8-Bit Up/Down Counter

pins.name: LD
pins.text: load: low loads D7-D0 at the clock edge

pins.name: UD
pins.text: up/down: low = count up (INCREMENT), high = count down (DECREMENT)

pins.name: OE
pins.text: output enable for Q0-Q7; high = high impedance; the counter keeps working

pins.name: CBO
pins.text: carry/borrow out: counting up (UD low), low when Q7-Q0 are all high; counting down (UD high), low when they are all low (and CBI is low); otherwise high

pins.name: CBI
pins.text: carry/borrow in: low lets the counter count; high turns counting into HOLD

functions.text: Shows counter bit 0 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high.
Shows counter bit 1 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high.
Shows counter bit 2 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high.
Shows counter bit 3 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high.
Shows counter bit 4 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high.
Shows counter bit 5 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high.
Shows counter bit 6 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high.
Shows counter bit 7 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high.

functions.formula: CBO = NOT(CBI' AND ((UD' AND FF0 AND FF1 AND FF2 AND FF3 AND FF4 AND FF5 AND FF6 AND FF7) OR (UD AND FF0' AND FF1' AND FF2' AND FF3' AND FF4' AND FF5' AND FF6' AND FF7')))
functions.text: carry/borrow out: counting up (UD low), low when Q7-Q0 are all high; counting down (UD high), low when they are all low (and CBI is low); otherwise high

rules: LD high, CBI low, UD low: INCREMENT (count up by one)
LD high, CBI low, UD high: DECREMENT (count down by one)

electrical.notes: Commercial figures (IOL and IOH are the VOL/VOH test currents; the book gives no separate recommended IOL/IOH). Off-state current +/-100 uA. Built as a hard-wired PAL (MMI HMSI).

unknown: CBO and CBI: the description says CBO is low when Q7-Q0 are all high (up) or all low (down), without naming CBI; the switching table gives a CBI-to-CBO delay, so CBI is taken to take part. Whether LD affects CBO is not stated.
Output type of CBO: the description says only the data outputs (Q) are three-state; totem-pole is taken from that, not stated.
The book gives one delay per path, not split into PLH and PHL; both edges carry the same figure here.
The function table's DECREMENT row is printed with CBI low (L); read from the scan at normal size.
notes: Military figures (book page 6-10): fmax 10.5 MHz, CBI-CBO 35/60, CK-Q 20/35, CK-CBO 55/95, enable/disable 20/45 ns typ/max; setup 60 ns, clock width 40 ns low, 30 ns high. Commercial clock low width also shows a typical 10 ns. Plain file: the lookup uses it for 74LS469.
